task: Escribe una entrada de diario (80–100 palabras) sobre un día especial de tu vida, con fecha y sentimientos.
paragraphs:
Monday 3 June
I've finally arrived at the turtle conservation centre on the coast of Costa Rica! The journey took almost two days, and I'm exhausted, but the beach is incredible. There are twelve volunteers from eight different countries. We sleep in wooden cabins with no air conditioning, so I'm going to have to get used to the heat.

Wednesday 5 June
Our first night patrol. We walked along the beach from 10 p.m. until 2 a.m. with red torches, because white light confuses the turtles. At about midnight we saw a huge leatherback turtle coming out of the sea to lay her eggs. Nobody spoke. Our coordinator, Diego, counted the eggs, ninety-two, and we moved them to the protected hatchery so that people and dogs couldn't take them.

Saturday 8 June
Hard week. Lots of beach cleaning in the morning heat. We collected forty bags of plastic in two days: bottles, flip-flops, fishing nets. It makes me angry, but it's also motivating, because we can see the difference immediately.

Thursday 20 June
The best day so far! The first eggs in the hatchery hatched tonight. We watched the tiny turtles run towards the waves under the moonlight. Diego told us that only about one in a thousand will survive to become an adult. That's why every single egg matters.

Sunday 30 June
My last day. I'm sad to leave, but I've learned so much: about turtles, about teamwork and about myself. I used to think one person couldn't change anything. Now I know that small actions, repeated by many people, really do make a difference.
